results.fact: Total elevation gain (gain_ft/itinerary vs approach prose & approach_variant's own gainFt)
results.evidence: Real contradiction, but it is a symptom of the row merging two different approaches: gain_ft 3900, the itinerary, beta, bail and the trailhead pin's 2,300 ft elevation/note describe the Denny Creek Trail -> Hemlock Pass approach, while approach, approach_variants, climbing_route, descent_text and the overview describe an Alpental -> Source Lake -> Bryant gully approach (trailhead ~3,100 ft). The Mountaineers route page confirms 3,900 ft gain / 9.5 mi RT from the Denny Creek trailhead (2,300 ft) via Hemlock Pass, so 3900 is right for that approach; no second source was found for the Source Lake approach's gain or mileage (its '9.5-mile round trip' looks copied from the Denny Creek figure). Fixing requires deciding which approach this route row describes and rewriting one set of fields - an editorial call, not a number swap. Also noted: summit 5,801 (overview/waypoint) vs 5,790 (approach, climbing_route).

results.correct_value: ~5,300 ft car to car from the Dingford gate (1,400 to the horse camp + ~3,800 camp-to-summit round trip + ~100 on the way out); summit day ~3,800 ft
results.evidence: The reader's internal resolution is backwards: day 2's 2,600 ft cannot reach a 6,540 ft summit from a camp near 2,800 ft (1,400 ft trailhead + 1,400 ft day 1). A 2023 trip report gives Dingford -> Horse Camp as 7.5 mi / 1,400 ft and the ford -> summit -> ford hike as 4.5 mi with 3,822 ft gain; a 2022 trip report gives the same start (1,400 ft), ~1,400 ft to the horse camp, the ford at Hardscrabble Creek and the NE gully at 5,400-5,800 ft. Summit 6,540 ft (Wikipedia). So day 2 is ~3,800 ft and the total ~5,300 ft; gain_ft 5140 (summit minus trailhead) was the net floor, and loss_ft 4100 was wrong too.

results.fact: Where the car is parked: road end vs Dingford gate
results.evidence: The approach, approach_logistics.trailheadDirection and waypoint[0] ('Dutch Miller Gap Trailhead', elev 2862, ford 0.1 mi away; approach says ~2,500 ft) tell a party to drive to the road end and ford beside the lot, but FS Road 56 has been gated at Dingford Creek since 2007 and the itinerary, cal, bivy and both trip reports start at Dingford (~1,400 ft) with a 7-7.5 mi road walk/bike to the horse camp.
